question: What thirty-twofold lordship and thirty-fourfold vastness characterize this divine manifestation?
premises: It is lord of the Bhairavas
It is a thirty-fourfold great lake
inference: This manifestation is the thirty-twofold lord of Bhairavas and the thirty-fourfold great lake.
plain_english: He is the thirty-twofold lord of the Bhairavas and the thirty-fourfold great lake.
